# Borsoga Studio

> Borsoga Studio is a Miami-based architectural visualization studio. We create photoreal 3D renders, CGI, immersive 360° tours, cinematic video, custom sales websites and brand identity that let people experience a building or interior before it is built. We work with real estate developers, architects, general contractors and custom millwork specialists — based in Miami, FL and working globally.

Tagline: "Digital spaces for the unbuilt imagination."

## What we do

- Architectural visualization & 3D rendering — exteriors, interiors, amenities
- Photorealistic CGI and still renders
- Immersive 360° virtual tours and walkthroughs
- Cinematic walkthrough and aerial video
- Architectural & interior photography and material studies
- Custom sales websites, web platforms and iOS sales apps
- Brand identity, naming and visual systems

## Who we work with

- Real estate developers & investors — sell pre-construction before it is built, with photoreal renders, video, 360° tours, project branding and a dedicated sales site.
- Architects & general contractors — translate CAD, materials and lighting into images that read the same to every stakeholder, so bids close and projects break ground faster.
- Custom millwork & carpentry specialists — workshop identity, a portfolio site, and finished pieces rendered in the client's actual room to justify a premium quote.

## Selected projects

- [RAL 1011 // Five Park Apartment](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-1011-five-park-apartment/): Interior CGI of an open-plan apartment in Five Park, Miami Beach
- [RAL 8003 // Wood Vein Kitchen & Closet](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-8003-wood-vein-kitchen-closet/): Interior space, photography and material study
- [RAL 9002 // Corner Residential Building](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-9002-corner-residential-building/): Exterior 3D visualization of a corner residential building (client: 3Design Architecture)
- [RAL 7006 // Coconut Grove Residence](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-7006-coconut-grove-residence/): Full interior CGI series of a high-end residence
- [RAL 1013 // Crystal River Residence](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-1013-crystal-river-residence/): Residence interior documented through photography and CGI
- [RAL 1002 // Double Island Kitchen](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-1002-double-island-kitchen/): High-resolution CGI rendering of a luxury kitchen
- [RAL 7022 // Umbra Stone Kitchen](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-7022-umbra-stone-kitchen/): Kitchen design, material and detail study
- [RAL 7013 // Garden View Kitchen & Dining](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-7013-garden-view-kitchen-dining/): Kitchen visualization with CGI and viewport captures
- [RAL 1015 // Pool Pavilion](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-1015-pool-pavilion/): Exterior pool area, concept design and visualization
- [RAL 4005 // Epsi Nest](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-4005-epsi-nest/): Proptech platform brand identity and UI/UX design
- [RAL 5002 // Peak Vision](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-5002-peak-vision/): Investment-firm brand identity and corporate design
- [RAL 9005 // Reframe](https://borsogastudio.com/works/ral-9005-reframe/): Real-estate-developer brand identity and visual system
